user_initiate_content_conversation.description: user initiates a conversation about the content following the flow of the conversation

ai_agree_to_help_with_content_conversati.description: ai agrees to help with the content conversation following the flow of the conversation

ai_ask_about_content_fields.description: ai asks about the content fields following the flow of the conversation

user_share_content_fields.description: user shares the content fields following the flow of the conversation

ai_confirm_content_writeup_complete.description: ai confirms that all information for the content has been gathered (works for any content type)

user_initiate_content_update_conversatio.description: user initiates a conversation about updating existing content

ai_agree_to_help_with_content_update.description: ai agrees to help update existing content

user_share_content_update.description: user shares a specific update to a content field

ai_acknowledge_content_update.description: ai acknowledges the content update and asks if there are more changes

user_confirm_content_updates_complete.description: user confirms that all content updates have been shared

user_initiate_content_delete_conversatio.description: user initiates a conversation about deleting content elements

ai_agree_to_help_with_content_delete.description: ai agrees to help with content deletion

user_share_content_delete.description: user shares what content elements to delete

ai_acknowledge_content_delete.description: ai acknowledges the content deletion and asks if there are more deletions

user_confirm_content_deletes_complete.description: user confirms that all content deletions have been shared
